name: deepwiki-codebase-wiki
description: Cross-platform DeepWiki workflow with source-grounded documentation, page-level orchestration, and corrected Mermaid edge-label authoring plus explicit parser/render validation.

interface.longDescription: An expanded ChatGPT package for the original DeepWiki Skill. It preserves the original six phases and workflow-runner execution contract, uses native subagents and page-level parallelism when the host supports them, falls back to the same phase contract when it does not, and provides a portable browser-based Mermaid.js preview without requiring an MCP server. The original upstream .apm skill remains untouched in the repository's main branch. Version 2.0.4 corrects pipe-delimited Mermaid edge-label syntax and requires explicit parser/render outcomes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DeepWiki's original six-phase workflow to create or update evidence-based codebase documentation. Preserve the workflow-runner contract, use page-level subagents when supported, and validate Mermaid diagrams with the portable browser renderer or the available CLI.
